topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: While V-band offers cost-efficiency and resilience to atmospheric attenuation, dense constellations amplify interference and degrade throughput.  Optical systems, with their inherent resilience, offer a more robust solution for such scenarios.  Adaptive beamforming and multi-beam antennas mitigate atmospheric interference, ensuring higher throughput and network performance in dense constellations.
